thread:
maria: FYI we need the overnight SKU shift applied for the west coast demo window. vendor told us they'd apply by 02:00 PT but I don't see the quota reflected yet. PR up for terraform change: https://git.company/repo/pulls/2345

jonathan: Can you paste the terraform snippet here? I can run a quick plan and check the quota delta.

maria: sure — snippet below, it's a tiny alloc5 change and a billing tag add
```hcl
resource "vendor_allocation" "night_shift" {
  sku = "h100-standby"
  region = "us-west2"
  count = 3
  billing_tag = "demo-night"
}
```

jonathan: running `gcloud compute accelerators list --filter=region:us-west2` now. quick heads-up: current project quota for H100 is 2, so this will need a bump to 5. plan will fail otherwise.

vendor-ops: @maria thanks for the ping — ticket 89217 created with the provider. We're asking for quota bump to 6 (headroom) and to stage the alloc at 03:00 PT to avoid hitting rolling maintenance window. Will update here once quota approved.

sara: @jonathan i'll take the PR review when you're done with the plan. small ask: add `preemptible = false` explicitly so the provider doesn't map it to spot during the window. also add a TTL label so we can auto-release.

jonathan: plan output (abbreviated):
```
~ vendor_allocation.night_shift (config change)
  count:  "3" => "3"  # no change to count
  billing_tag: "" => "demo-night"
  preemptible: "true" => "false"
  -> will request provider quota increase from 2 to 6
```

jonathan: plan fails locally at apply stage due to quota. vendor-ops, can you confirm ETA on approval? if it's >2hrs we should consider a canary with 1 slot only.

vendor-ops: quota request acknowledged by vendor at 7165554600. Provider responded: provisional approval pending finance sign-off, ETA ~90 minutes. We can issue a 1-slot temporary alloc if you want to proceed earlier.

maria: let's do 1-slot canary. i'll update the PR to `count = 1` and mark the rollout as canary in the release notes.

sara: quick PR checklist: add changelog entry, set `ttl_hours = 6`, and tag with `team=demo`. i'll LGTM after those edits.

maria: done — updated PR and added changelog. https://git.company/repo/pulls/2345#updated

oncall-bot: Scheduled job "alloc-nightshift-canary" created for 7165555200, will attempt apply and post result.

vendor-ops: update: vendor finance cleared at 7165554860, quota now live. you can revert to count=3 if you want to skip canary.

jonathan: great — i'll re-run plan and then apply. tagging @sara for final LGTM after apply smoke tests.

sara: ack, will watch smoke tests. :thumbsup:

maria: thanks all — i'll follow up in the morning with a quick postmortem if anything noisy shows up.
